claims.text: The baselines include the Hub5 Year 2000 evaluation dataset, which is divided into Switchboard and Callhome subsets, and the 2000hr Fisher+Switchboard training data.
The models evaluated include the Jasper model trained with SGD for 50 epochs, compared against other models using the same data.
The study also mentions the use of statistical N-gram language models and neural Transformer-XL models as part of the evaluation.
